title: Piano players in Chicago houses and the Everleigh Club
summary: He worked houses in Louisville, not Chicago; the Everleigh Club used mostly white players such as Nora Holt.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Tell me, did the district here in Chicago use piano players much? Did you ever work any of the houses there? No, they worked at any houses in Chicago. We're working all of them in Louisville. In Louisville. Not up here. All the big houses. Did the big places like the Everly Club, were they running when you were here?
Did they use a piano player?
Did Tony or Jelly ever play at these places? No, not at the Everly Club, no.
They used, uh, Nora Holt. Played at the Everly Club for years.
